about:
G & G Electric Supply is a family-owned electrical supply distributor based in New York, New York. The company was founded in 1914 and is now in its fourth generation of family leadership as it approaches its 110th anniversary.

The company operates as a distributor of electrical supplies, offering categories such as service entrance cable, fasteners and hardware, fixture mounting hardware, Nest products and accessories, and various parts and accessories. Its listed capability includes service entrance cable, and its product catalog spans fasteners, fixture mounting hardware, Nest accessories, and general parts. The company maintains an online storefront at ggelectric.com that allows product search and mobile purchasing. Specific details about facility size, headcount, or annual volume are not publicly disclosed.

The company's customer base includes buyers of electrical supplies such as service entrance cable, fasteners, and fixture mounting hardware, though specific industry verticals are not listed in available sources.

The company highlights its longevity and continuous family ownership as a key differentiator, noting nearly 110 years of operation under fourth-generation leadership.
